units.source_text: 庭中秋草皆已枯萎，只有芒草与众不同，仿佛伸出了手，向人招徕，颇有风趣。

en.t: All the autumn grasses in the garden had withered, but the pampas grass alone seemed different, as if it were stretching out its hands to beckon people, and it had a certain charm.

units.source_text: 更有尚未生穗的芒草，也像穿着露珠的丝线，细弱无力地望风披靡。

en.t: There were also pampas grasses that had not yet put forth their plumes, like fine threads strung with dewdrops, bending weakly before the wind.

units.source_text: 此景虽属寻常，但当此晚风萧瑟之时，亦足催人哀思。

en.t: Though the scene was ordinary enough, in this bleak evening wind it was still enough to stir sorrowful thoughts.
